note: Remotion's single-pass --video-bitrate=4M undershoots for this flat 2D content (libx264 ABR won't pad bits below complexity need). Re-encoded (same frames/audio, no re-render) with ffmpeg -x264-params nal-hrd=cbr:force-cfr=1 -b:v 4M -minrate 4M -maxrate 4M -bufsize 4M to force true CBR via filler NALs.
